cohort: 19,717 Japanese children with GHD who were determined to be eligible for GH treatment between 1996 and 2015
finding: The study identified the characteristics and changes in Japanese children with GHD over 20 years, finding an increasing trend in caesarean section and a decreasing trend in breech delivery and asphyxia.
mod_finding: The proportions of breech delivery and asphyxia gradually decreased, whereas that of caesarean section gradually increased during the registration period.
